words.definition: להעריך ולבחון משהו בצורה שיטתית ומעמיקה
words.example: We need to assess the risks before making a decision.

words.definition: לתרום – לתת משהו כדי לסייע למטרה משותפת
words.example: Everyone should contribute to protecting the environment.

words.definition: למרות – אחריו שם עצם (לא משפט): despite the rain
words.example: Despite the heavy traffic, she arrived on time.

words.definition: יעיל – עושה את העבודה בפחות משאבים וזמן
words.example: The new system is much more efficient than the old one.
Trust is fundamental to any good relationship.

words.definition: לנהל משא ומתן – לדון ולהגיע להסכמה
words.example: The two companies negotiated a new deal.

words.definition: נקודת מבט – האופן שבו אדם רואה ומפרש מצב
words.example: From a different perspective, the problem looks simpler.
There has been a significant improvement in her grades.

words.definition: בעוד ש, לעומת זאת – מציין הפרש בין שני דברים
words.example: She likes classical music, whereas her brother prefers rock.

words.definition: לפרט ולהרחיב, לספק מידע נוסף על נושא
words.example: Could you elaborate on your idea? I'd like to understand more.

lessons.title: Passive Voice (גוף סביל)
lessons.explanation:
גוף סביל (Passive Voice) מדגיש את מושא הפעולה, לא את מבצעה.

מבנה: to be + past participle (V3)

דוגמאות לפי זמנים:
• Present: The report is written by the manager. (הדו"ח נכתב על ידי המנהל)
• Past: The book was published in 2010. (הספר פורסם ב-2010)
• Present Perfect: The project has been completed. (הפרויקט הושלם)
• Future: The results will be announced tomorrow. (התוצאות יוכרזו מחר)

מתי להשתמש:
• כשלא יודעים מי עשה את הפעולה
• כשהפעולה חשובה יותר מהמבצע
• בטקסטים פורמליים ומדעיים

by + מבצע הפעולה (agent) – נוסיף רק כשחשוב לציין מי עשה.

questions.question: Change to passive: 'The chef cooked the meal.'
options: The meal cooked by the chef
The meal was cooked by the chef
The meal is cooked the chef
The meal were cooked by the chef
questions.explanation: המבנה הנכון לעבר פשוט סביל: subject + was/were + past participle. 'The meal' יחיד, לכן 'was'. + 'by the chef'.

questions.question: 'The new bridge ___ next year.' – Future passive.
questions.explanation: עתיד סביל: will be + past participle. 'will be built' = יבנה. 'is built' = הווה סביל, 'was built' = עבר סביל.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: A new planet was discovered by scientists
Scientists have discovered a new planet
Scientists are discovering a new planet
questions.explanation: 'A new planet was discovered by scientists' – הנושא (the planet) מקבל את הפעולה. זהו גוף סביל. שאר המשפטים הם גוף פעיל.

lessons.title: Reported Speech (דיבור עקיף)
lessons.explanation:
דיבור עקיף (Reported Speech) משמש כשאנחנו מעבירים מה שאמר מישהו אחר.

שינויים עיקריים:
• הפועל 'לאמור' + that: She said that...
• זמנים נדחים אחורה:
  - is → was
  - am working → was working
  - will → would
  - can → could
  - has done → had done

דוגמאות:
• Direct: 'I am tired.' → Reported: She said (that) she was tired.
• Direct: 'I will call you.' → Reported: He said he would call me.
• Direct: 'I can swim.' → Reported: She said she could swim.

כינויים גם משתנים:
• 'I love you.' → He said he loved her.
• 'We are ready.' → They said they were ready.

questions.question: Direct: 'I work in a bank.' – What is the reported speech?
options: He said he works in a bank
He said he worked in a bank
He said I worked in a bank
He says he worked in a bank
questions.explanation: בדיבור עקיף, works (הווה) נדחה ל-worked (עבר). גם 'I' הופך ל-'he'. המשפט הנכון: He said he worked in a bank.

questions.question: Direct: 'She will help you.' → Reported: He said...
questions.explanation: 'will' הופך ל-'would' בדיבור עקיף. גם 'you' הופך ל-'me'. He said she would help me.

questions.question: Which reported speech is correct for: 'I can't come today.'
options: She said she can't come today
She said she couldn't come that day
She said I can't come today
She said she won't come today
questions.explanation: 'can't' הופך ל-'couldn't'. 'today' הופך ל-'that day' (שינוי ביטוי זמן). She said she couldn't come that day.

questions.question: 'The documents ___ by the lawyer yesterday.'
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' מציין עבר, ולכן עבר סביל: were signed. 'were' כי 'documents' הם רבים.

questions.question: What does 'whereas' express?
questions.explanation: 'whereas' מביע ניגוד/הבדל: She is outgoing, whereas he is shy. Because = סיבה, Therefore = תוצאה, If = תנאי.

questions.question: Direct: 'I have finished.' → Reported: She said...
questions.explanation: 'has finished' (הווה מושלם) הופך ל-'had finished' (עבר מושלם) בדיבור עקיף.

questions.question: 'Despite ___ hard, he failed the exam.'
questions.explanation: אחרי 'despite' משתמשים ב-gerund (verb+ing): despite studying. אחרי 'although' משתמשים במשפט מלא.

questions.question: What does 'elaborate' mean in context?
questions.explanation: 'elaborate' = לפרט, לספק פרטים נוספים. Could you elaborate on that? = האם תוכל לפרט יותר?

questions.question: Which is the most formal way to express contrast?
questions.explanation: 'However' הוא הפורמלי ביותר מבין האפשרויות, נפוץ בכתיבה אקדמית ועסקית. 'But' הוא הכי יומיומי.

questions.question: 'She ___ to negotiate a better salary.' – Choose correctly.
questions.explanation: 'managed to' = הצליח ל- (עבר). 'managed to negotiate' נכון. 'succeeded' דורש 'succeeded in negotiating'.

questions.question: 'The project is ___ to be completed by Friday.'
questions.explanation: המבנה הוא: is expected to + infinitive. 'The project is expected to be completed' – גוף סביל עם ציפייה.

questions.question: What does 'significant' mean?
questions.explanation: 'significant' = משמעותי, חשוב. Small = קטן, Temporary = זמני, Complex = מסובך.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about contribution:
options: She contributes to the project since last year
She has been contributing to the project since last year
She is contributed to the project
questions.explanation: 'since last year' מצריך Present Perfect Continuous: has been contributing. 'contribute to' = לתרום ל (דורש to).
